title: Starting to arrange with Tate, and studying arranging with Sanborn
summary: He began writing brass sections for Tate, then whole arrangements for Hines, and had studied arranging with Sanborn as a boy.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: I started arranging when I was with Tate. I started arranging like Omer Simeon would arrange the saxaphone chords, I'd arrange the brass chords. They'd have what they called special courses. That's when I first started arranging.
What attracted you about tuba writing?
I didn't like to write. Then after I wrote a couple of brass chords and I heard it, I was fascinated with what I wrote. So when I went with Earl, I started making whole arrangements. The whole thing.
Did you ever study arranging or composing?
When I was taking fiddle lessons in harmony and theory and arranging. I studied under him.
So you were getting that when you were 10, 11, 12, 13 years old?
